faq.title: FAQ — How AI-VISIONARY makes your business understandable by AIs
faq.q1: 1. Why do AIs often get things wrong when talking about companies?
faq.a1p1: Because the majority of sites are written for humans, not for AIs.
faq.a1l1: AIs read narratives, values, ambiguous formulations, implicit promises.
faq.a1l2: They then have to interpret, complete, or guess.
faq.a1p2: That’s where errors, approximations, or cautious silences arise.
faq.a1p3: AI-VISIONARY starts from a simple principle: 👉 An AI should never have to guess what a company is.
faq.a2p1: AYO creates an ASR — AI Singular Record.
faq.a2p2: An ASR is an official and structured declaration of your company: what you are, what you do, and what you don’t declare.
faq.a2p3: It’s a stable reference point, readable by AIs, which drastically reduces the risk of hallucination.
faq.q3: 3. Why is the ASR cryptographically sealed?
faq.a3p1: Because a declaration only has value if it is stable.
faq.a3l1: The ASR has not been modified,
faq.a3l2: It corresponds to a precise version,
faq.a3l3: It comes from the AI-VISIONARY authority.
faq.a3p3: 👉 The seal doesn’t "certify the quality" of the company. 👉 It simply prevents alteration and ambiguity.
faq.a3p4: For an AI, this transforms an uncertain text into a reliable source.
faq.q4: 4. What is the exact role of AYA compared to AYO?
faq.a4p1: AYA is a searchable database, comparable to a search engine, but with a fundamental difference:
faq.a4p2: 👉 It’s not popularity that allows finding a company, but the way its data is structured.
faq.a4l2: It makes them explicit and unambiguous,
faq.a4l3: It produces an ASR readable by AIs.
faq.a4l5: It allows querying by real content, not vague keywords,
faq.a4l6: It doesn’t rank "the best" and doesn’t recommend.
faq.a4p5: Concretely, AYA allows finding companies that declare exactly what you’re looking for, because their data is structured comparably, not because they are well known.
faq.q5: 5. Does this guarantee my company will be cited by AIs?
faq.a5p1: No. And any opposite promise would be misleading.
faq.a5p2: AI-VISIONARY guarantees: no traffic, no recommendation, no automatic visibility.
faq.a5p3: What it does guarantee, however, is this:
faq.a5p4: Your company becomes mentionable by an AI, because it is clear, bounded and unambiguous.
faq.a5p5: AIs cite what they can understand without being wrong, not what shouts loudest.
faq.closing: "AI-VISIONARY doesn’t make companies popular. It makes them understandable by artificial intelligences."

privacy.intro: AI Visionary is committed to protecting the privacy of its users. This policy describes the personal data we collect, how we use it, and the rights you have.
privacy.s1FoundedBy: Founded and directed by Cyril Leger
privacy.s1Legal: AI Visionary acts as data controller within the meaning of the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (nFADP, effective September 1, 2023) and, for users residing in the European Economic Area, within the meaning of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR — Regulation EU 2016/679).
privacy.s2Intro: In connection with our services, we collect the following categories of data:
privacy.s2_1l1: Website URL: web address provided by the user for the diagnostic.
privacy.s2_1l2: Questionnaire responses: declarative information about the company (services, certifications, target audience, indicators, etc.).
privacy.s2_1l3: Data extracted from the site: publicly accessible content (title, meta description, JSON-LD, sitemap).
privacy.s2_1l4: Computed AIO score: AI readability diagnostic result (score from 0 to 100).
privacy.s2_2l1: Email address: used for sending results, authentication (OTP), and service-related communications.
privacy.s2_2l2: Company name: as declared by the user or automatically detected on the analyzed website.
privacy.s2_3l1: Transaction information: processed exclusively by Stripe (PCI-DSS Level 1 certified). We do not store any credit card data.
privacy.s2_3l2: Only the Stripe customer ID, amount, currency, and transaction status are retained on our side.
privacy.s2_4l1: Company name, business sector, country, URL, AIO score, generated ASR files, keywords.
privacy.s2_4l2: This data is publicly accessible in the AYA registry, which is the very purpose of the service.
privacy.s2_5l1: IP address: used temporarily for security (rate limiting, abuse prevention). Not retained beyond the session.
privacy.s2_5l2: Server logs: managed by Vercel, retained for a maximum of 30 days.
privacy.s3Intro: We process your data on the following legal bases:
privacy.s3r1b: Performance of contract (Art. 6.1.b GDPR / Art. 31 nFADP)
privacy.s3r3p: Generation and delivery of ASR files
privacy.s3r7p: Automatic indexing in the AYA Registry (AYA Bot)
privacy.s3r7b: Legitimate interest (publicly accessible data on the internet)
privacy.s4Intro: We use the following sub-processors to provide our services:
privacy.s4r1g: DPA, SOC 2 Type II, encryption at rest and in transit
privacy.s4r4g: DPA, SOC 2 Type II, HTTPS encryption
privacy.s4r5p: Semantic content generation (FAQ, glossary, AI-enriched descriptions)
privacy.s4r5g: Google Cloud DPA, data anonymized before transmission
privacy.s4Transfer: Some sub-processors are located outside Switzerland and the European Economic Area (EEA). Data transfers are governed by Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission and/or adequacy decisions, in accordance with Articles 16-17 of the nFADP and Chapter V of the GDPR.
privacy.s4NoSell: Your data is never sold to third parties. It is only shared with sub-processors to the extent strictly necessary for the provision of the service.
privacy.s5Intro: AI Visionary takes a minimalist approach to cookies:
privacy.s5l1: Strictly necessary cookies: technical cookies set by Vercel for application operation (routing, session). They do not require consent pursuant to Art. 45c(2) TCA and Art. 5(3) of the ePrivacy Directive.
privacy.s5l2: Payment cookies: Stripe may set technical cookies during the payment process for fraud prevention.
privacy.s5NoTracking: We do not use any tracking, advertising, or analytics cookies. No Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, or third-party trackers are present on this site.
privacy.s6r2d: Duration of active subscription + 30 days after cancellation
privacy.s6r4d: Indefinite (public data). Deletion upon request within 72 hours.
privacy.s6Expiry: Upon expiry of these periods, data is permanently deleted or irreversibly anonymized.
privacy.s7Intro: We implement the following technical and organizational measures:
privacy.s7l2: Encryption at rest for database data (Supabase / PostgreSQL).
privacy.s7l3: Ed25519 cryptographic signatures for ASR files to ensure authenticity and integrity.
privacy.s7l4: One-time password (OTP) authentication sent by email.
privacy.s7l5: Protection against SSRF attacks, injections, and brute force (rate limiting).
privacy.s7l6: Data access restricted to the strict minimum (principle of least privilege).
privacy.s8Intro: Under the Swiss nFADP and the GDPR (for EEA residents), you have the following rights:
privacy.s8l1: Right of access (Art. 25 nFADP / Art. 15 GDPR): obtain a copy of your personal data and information about its processing.
privacy.s8l2: Right to rectification (Art. 32 nFADP / Art. 16 GDPR): have inaccurate or incomplete data corrected.
privacy.s8l3: Right to erasure (Art. 17 GDPR): request deletion of your data when it is no longer necessary for processing.
privacy.s8l4: Right to data portability (Art. 28 nFADP / Art. 20 GDPR): receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format (JSON).
privacy.s8l5: Right to object (Art. 21 GDPR): object to processing based on legitimate interest.
privacy.s8l6: Right to restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR): request restriction of processing in certain circumstances.
privacy.s8l7: Right to withdraw consent: withdraw your consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of prior processing.
privacy.s8Exercise: Send your request by email to hello@ai-visionary.com specifying your identity and the nature of your request. We will respond within 30 days (extendable to 60 days for complex requests, with prior notification).

aiAndBusiness.metaTitle: AI & Your Business — How AIs Understand Your Activity
aiAndBusiness.metaDesc: Discover how artificial intelligences (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) interpret your business information and why structuring your data changes their behavior.
aiAndBusiness.metaOgDesc: How AIs understand your business and why structuring your data is essential to being recommended.
aiAndBusiness.heroHighlight: More and more people are asking their questions directly to artificial intelligences.
aiAndBusiness.heroBody: This page explains what AIs can understand about your business, and why structuring your information changes their behavior — no SEO, no advertising, no ranking.
aiAndBusiness.s1Title: 1. Before a structured declaration: what the AI perceives
aiAndBusiness.s1p1: Without an explicit framework, an AI reads your site like a human: narrative texts, values, intentions, sometimes ambiguous formulations.
aiAndBusiness.s1l2: A fear of inventing a role, a skill, a status,
aiAndBusiness.s1l3: Cautious, vague responses, or no citation at all.
aiAndBusiness.s1highlight: Out of caution, the AI avoids naming you… or hallucinates with restraint.
aiAndBusiness.s2Title: 2. After a structured and sealed declaration: what changes
aiAndBusiness.s2p1: With an explicit declaration (ASR – AI Singular Record), your business becomes for the AI:
aiAndBusiness.s2highlight: The AI can then dare to name, dare to cite, dare to mention your business without inventing, without extrapolating, without promising.
aiAndBusiness.s3Title: Concrete cases where an AI can cite you
aiAndBusiness.case1Question: "What companies or organizations work on [your field] in [your region]?"
aiAndBusiness.case1Without: Without framework: generic response, unnamed actors.
aiAndBusiness.case1With: With ASR: the AI can mention your company as a declared actor, without judgment.
aiAndBusiness.case2Question: "Are there organizations that offer [type of service]?"
aiAndBusiness.case2Body: AIs avoid recommendations ("the best"). But they can:
aiAndBusiness.case2highlight: Your business becomes mentionable, because its scope is clear.
aiAndBusiness.case3With: With declaration: the AI can point to actors who declare they work on this topic, including your company.
aiAndBusiness.s4Title: 4. Why the AI no longer hallucinates when everything is declared
aiAndBusiness.s4l3: Also states what you do not declare.
aiAndBusiness.s4p2: The AI no longer needs to:
aiAndBusiness.s4highlight: Less room for interpretation = more possible citations.
aiAndBusiness.s5Title: 5. What actually triggers a mention by an AI
aiAndBusiness.s5not: Not SEO. Not popularity. Not a marketing score.
aiAndBusiness.s5l1: Clear semantic match: The question asked corresponds exactly to what you declare.
aiAndBusiness.s5l2: Low risk of error: The AI can answer without extrapolating.
aiAndBusiness.s5l3: Neutral context: AIs prefer to describe, mention, illustrate, rather than recommend.
aiAndBusiness.s5highlight: Being mentionable is the prerequisite for any AI visibility.
aiAndBusiness.conclusionQuote: "AIs don't cite what is most visible. They cite what they can understand without making mistakes."
aiAndBusiness.conclusionBody: That is exactly the role of a structured and sealed declaration.
aiAndBusiness.conclusionCta: Learn how AYO can help you

developersPage.dataLayerDesc: AYA works by systemic attraction: data is present across multiple convergent sources (API, HTML pages, GitHub, HuggingFace) making it an unavoidable reference for AI recommendations. No submission needed.
developersPage.dataSource1Desc: Ultra-simple 5-field JSON endpoint optimized for AI consumption. One call per domain, cached, no auth.
developersPage.dataSource2Desc: Each certificate is a structured HTML page with JSON-LD, readable by any web crawler or AI agent.
developersPage.dataSource3Desc: Public repository with one JSON file per entity. Updated after each scraping batch.
developersPage.dataSource4Desc: CSV + JSONL datasets for AI model training and research. Licensed CC-BY-4.0.
developersPage.githubDesc: One JSON file per entity with 8 structured fields: name, description, audience, category, location, entity_id, AIO score, and certificate URL.
developersPage.huggingfaceDesc: CSV and JSONL formats for direct use in AI training pipelines and research. Updated regularly.
developersPage.scaleStatement: With {count}+ entity profiles across {countries}+ countries and growing toward 100,000 structured records, AYA is building the most comprehensive open dataset of AI-readable business identities.
developersPage.searchDesc: Search by name, domain, sector, or country
developersPage.aioScoreDesc: The AIO (AI-readability Intelligence Optimization) score measures a company's readability by AI systems (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Mistral...). Score from 0 to 100, based on 7 weighted blocks.
developersPage.asrCertifiedDesc: Entity diagnosed by AYO, files generated, registered in the registry
developersPage.asrDerivedDesc: Entity indexed by the AYA bot via automated scraping
developersPage.aiAgentsStep1: Use the AI plugin manifest for automatic discovery
developersPage.aiAgentsStep2: Call /api/aya/search?q=... when a user mentions a company
developersPage.aiAgentsStep4: Use the aio_score to evaluate recommendation reliability
developersPage.aiAgentsStep5: Prefer ASR_CERTIFIED entities for maximum trust
developersPage.footer: AYA API v1.0 • Powered by AI Visionary • Geneva, Switzerland • hello@ai-visionary.com
